name: Gangtok, East, North and South Sikkim trip
route: PICKUP from Siliguri/NJP/Bagdogra → Gangtok → EAST SIKKIM → Gangtok → Lachung → Yumthang VALLEY and ZERO POINT → Lachung → Gangtok → Gang → Namchi

itinerary.title: PICKUP from Siliguri/NJP/Bagdogra
itinerary.desc: Hotel on MG ROAD (no extra travelling cost) Visit MG MARG and LAL MARKET in 1 min walk East Sikkim feels like the mountains whispering stories only slow travelers can hear."

itinerary.title: Gangtok to EAST SIKKIM
itinerary.desc: Visit the magical Tsomgo lake, Experience highest opeway in Asia (14,000 ft) Nathula Pass (Indo-China border) Baba Harbhajan Singh Mandir Stay in Gangtok "Every turn in Gangtok feels like a postcard."

itinerary.title: Local sight seeing in Gangtok
itinerary.desc: includes 7 points in and around Gangtok Experience Ropeway of Gangtok Tashi view point Hanuman Tok & Ganesh Tok Bulbulay Falls ( enjoy Zipline adventure) Enchey Monastery Himalayan Zoological Park Stay in Gangtok “Snowy destinations remind us that even the coldest places can foci magical."

itinerary.title: Gangtok to Lachung
itinerary.desc: Enroute SEVEN SISTER waterfalls and AMITABH BACHCHAN waterfalls stay in Lachung

itinerary.title: Yumthang VALLEY and ZERO POINT
itinerary.desc: Experience Yumthang valley (vallery of Flowers-feb to june) SNOW covered ZERO POINT like never before (snow season nov to march/april ) stay in Lachung

itinerary.title: Lachung to Gangtok
itinerary.desc: Reach Gangtok by 2 PM Stay in Gangtok South Sikkim, wrapped in green calm."

itinerary.title: Gangtok to Namchi
itinerary.desc: Drive to Namchi (approx. 4-5 hours drive). Check into your hotel and explore the local market. Enjoy panoramic view from Tarey Bhit Visit the Char Dham in the afternoon, a replica of all four main Hindu pilgrimage sites. Overnight stay at your hotel

itinerary.title: Nameni & Ravangla Exploration
itinerary.desc: Visit Samdruptse Hill, home to the world's largest statue of Guru Padmasambhava and enjoy panoramic views. Drive to Ravangla (approx. 1-2 hours). Visit the Buddha Park, featuring a magnificent statue of Buddha ( Tallest Buddha Statue in Sikkim). Explore Ravangla town and visit the Temi Tea Garden, the only Tea Estate in Sikkim. Stay in Ravangla

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: NJP/Bagdogra/Siliguri drop to RAILWAY STATION, AIRPORT and HOTELS

inclusions: Accommodation in double & triple sharing (Deluxe rooms)
exclusions: Any kind of activity charges and entry fees
Zero point extra according to Govt rule
essentialTips: 4. Reusable Water Bottle (Xuse and throw bottles not allowed]
8. Oxygen can (for North & East Sikkim - you can purchase after reaching Gangtok)
